headline: Toyota Global Production and Sales Fall for Fourth Consecutive Month in October
summary: Toyota Motor reported an 8.1% decline in global production to 852,109 vehicles in October, marking its fourth straight month of contraction.
why: Global automotive production volumes serve as a primary indicator of manufacturing sector health, supply chain throughput, and consumer demand.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor Corporation
impacts.why: Global production declines for four consecutive months signal softening unit sales and output.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent year-over-year declines in global manufacturing output and vehicle sales point to ongoing operational headwinds.
